app_type: dashboard (Internal CRM report table, React + Tailwind CSS + shadcn/ui, lucide-react)

design_direction.archetype: Swiss Precision Operations with International Navy Accent (#002FA7)
aesthetic_principles: Rigid Swiss data architecture: Functional tabular hierarchy, no wasted pixels, 100% full-width span with no blank filler columns
Tactile readability: High-density rows with comfortable breathing room (py-3 to py-3.5 instead of cramped py-1)
High visual clarity on deltas: Dark emerald (+ve) vs bold signal red (-ve) with clean directional glyphs
Optical sticky anchor: Customer column is pinned left with distinct solid background, crisp right separator border and micro-shadow for horizontal scroll context

hierarchy.table_header: text-[11px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500 select-none
hierarchy.customer_name: text-sm font-semibold text-primary hover:underline hover:text-primary/90 truncate block
hierarchy.customer_secondary: None - Account ID has been removed as per user instruction

table_layout_strategy.container_classes: w-full overflow-x-auto rounded-2xl border border-slate-200/90 bg-white shadow-sm
table_layout_strategy.width_mode: table-fixed (fills 100% of parent width, distributed across columns without blank trailing th/td dummy columns)

col_customer.th_class: sticky left-0 z-30 w-[30%] min-w-[280px] max-w-[480px] bg-slate-50/95 px-4 py-3.5 text-left border-r border-slate-200/80 shadow-[2px_0_6px_-2px_rgba(0,0,0,0.06)]
col_customer.td_class: sticky left-0 z-20 w-[30%] min-w-[280px] max-w-[480px] px-4 py-3.5 text-left border-r border-slate-200/80 shadow-[2px_0_6px_-2px_rgba(0,0,0,0.06)] truncate
col_customer.behavior: Takes ~28-32% of viewport space, allowing full customer name to be visible without premature ellipsis on 1280px–1920px screens

col_months_1_to_6.th_class: w-[10%] min-w-[100px] px-3 py-3.5 text-right whitespace-nowrap
col_months_1_to_6.td_class: w-[10%] min-w-[100px] px-3 py-3.5 text-right whitespace-nowrap tabular-nums

col_delta.th_class: w-[10%] min-w-[115px] px-4 py-3.5 text-right whitespace-nowrap bg-slate-50/50
col_delta.td_class: w-[10%] min-w-[115px] px-4 py-3.5 text-right whitespace-nowrap tabular-nums
col_delta.behavior: Final column showing difference between current month and last month (Δ vs last month)

table_layout_strategy.removal_spec: DO NOT render the empty trailing `<th className="w-full" />` or empty `<td />` columns. With table-fixed and percentage widths (30% + 6x10% + 10% = 100%), the table naturally occupies 100% width with zero shrinkage and zero dead spacer columns.

sortable_headers_spec.header_button_classes: inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 group font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500 hover:text-slate-900 transition-colors focus:outline-none

icon_states.inactive: ArrowUpDown className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-slate-300 group-hover:text-slate-500 transition-colors"

trend_indicator_rules: Compare month [i] to previous month [i-1] (for first month, compare against r.prev_month).
Higher revenue (v > prev): Dark green up indicator: ArrowUp (h-3 w-3 text-emerald-700 strokeWidth=2.5)
Lower revenue (v < prev): Red down indicator: ArrowDown (h-3 w-3 text-red-600 strokeWidth=2.5)
Equal revenue (v === prev) or no baseline: No arrow, clean display
Zero revenue: Display numeric '0' in text-slate-300 (not blank, not dash)
delta_column_rules: Positive delta (v > 0): text-emerald-700 font-semibold, prefixed with '+', e.g., +₹14,500 or +14,500
Negative delta (v < 0): text-red-600 font-bold, prefixed with '−', e.g., −22,300
trend_and_delta_styling.current_month_badge: Rendered on current month column header: `current`

customer_cell_leads_style.name_link: font-medium text-primary hover:text-primary/90 hover:underline truncate text-sm transition-colors
customer_cell_leads_style.no_account_id: CRITICAL: Do NOT render account_id under customer name (user choice: 'Take out the account Id underneath the customer name').

filter_bar_and_summary_strip.summary_strip_layout: flex flex-wrap items-center gap-x-6 gap-y-2 rounded-xl bg-slate-50 border border-slate-200/80 px-4 py-2.5 text-xs text-slate-600 font-normal shadow-xs
summary_items: Invoiced count: {count} invoiced in period
Legend: up / down vs prev
filter_bar_and_summary_strip.filter_bar_layout: flex flex-col gap-3 rounded-2xl border border-slate-200/90 bg-white p-3.5 shadow-sm lg:flex-row lg:items-center
filter_bar_and_summary_strip.hide_zero_toggle: inline-flex items-center gap-2 text-xs font-medium text-slate-700 cursor-pointer select-none
filter_bar_and_summary_strip.clear_filters_button: text-xs font-semibold text-[#002FA7] hover:text-[#00268a] underline underline-offset-4 decoration-dotted

default_distributor_rule.behavior: When the API returns `default_distributor_id` (matched to the logged-in user's assigned distributor or city), default the distributor state to that ID on initial load.
default_distributor_rule.badge_display: In the page header subtitle, display `Defaulted to {defaultName} (your city)` when distributor filter matches `default_distributor_id`.

responsive_breakdown.screens_1280px_to_1920px: Table fits 100% of the viewport width without horizontal scroll clipping when window is full screen. Customer column expands naturally to ~380-480px, displaying full company names comfortably.
responsive_breakdown.screens_under_1280px: The table preserves a min-width of 1050px inside `overflow-x-auto` to protect numeric tabular columns from awkward line breaks, with sticky left Customer column maintaining position.
responsive_breakdown.mobile_under_640px: Filter bar stacks vertically, action buttons group cleanly in header, table scrolls smoothly with touch momentum.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Replace the cramped table layout in /app/frontend/src/pages/CustomerInvoiceOverview.jsx with a full-width `table-fixed` structure.
2. Remove the trailing empty `<th className="w-full" />` and `<td />` spacer columns completely so the table expands evenly across 100% width.
3. Set Customer column to ~30% width (`w-[30%] min-w-[280px] max-w-[480px]`) and month columns to 10% each, delta column to 10% for an exact 100% total distribution.
4. Increase row padding to `py-3.5` on headers and body cells (up from py-1) to create comfortable visual breathing room.
5. Highlight the customer name using `font-medium text-primary truncate hover:underline` similar to LeadsList.js, without rendering any account_id underneath.

6. Implement client-side sorting on all columns (Customer name asc/desc, each of the 6 month columns asc/desc by numeric value, and Δ column asc/desc). Display active sort direction indicator (ArrowUp / ArrowDown) and inactive indicator (ArrowUpDown).
7. Alternate row striping using `bg-white` and `bg-slate-50/75` with matching backgrounds on the sticky Customer column.
8. Ensure the sticky left Customer column has `border-r border-slate-200/80` and subtle shadow `shadow-[2px_0_6px_-2px_rgba(0,0,0,0.06)]` so horizontal scrolling has clean separation.
9. Retain the Excel export, distributor filter default, customer multi-select combobox, and all `data-testid` attributes.
